iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: FreeSurfer fsaverage template (the fsaverage6 vertex set, pial surface)
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: Computed by NEMAR (ieeg_geometry 0.1.0) from sub-p05/ses-nyuecog01/ieeg/sub-p05_ses-nyuecog01_acq-clinical_electrodes.tsv, 138 cortical contacts; method: each contact within 3.0 mm of the subject pial surface (median 1.58 mm, maximum 2.94 mm) was moved to the fsaverage6 vertex that the subject's FreeSurfer sphere.reg registration assigns to its nearest pial vertex, so positions are on fsaverage6 vertices by construction; evidence: electrodes taken as the subject's surface (tkr) RAS as declared, the subject-side fit of the cortical contacts to the subject's own pial surface gives median 1.60 mm, 90th percentile 2.63 mm (specific); registration check: 2007 subject pial vertices mapped through sphere.reg: 99.2% on the correct hemisphere side, centroid 2.39 mm from fsaverage6 pial, extent within 2.5%, affine consistency residual median 5.80 mm; inputs: derivatives/freesurfer/sub-p05/surf/lh.pial, derivatives/freesurfer/sub-p05/surf/lh.sphere.reg, derivatives/freesurfer/sub-p05/surf/rh.pial, derivatives/freesurfer/sub-p05/surf/rh.sphere.reg, sub-p05/ses-nyuecog01/ieeg/sub-p05_ses-nyuecog01_acq-clinical_coordsystem.json, sub-p05/ses-nyuecog01/ieeg/sub-p05_ses-nyuecog01_acq-clinical_electrodes.tsv; contacts of the source file not placed: 26 depth or unknown-type contacts (affine template positions are too inaccurate to commit); 10 cortical contacts more than 3.0 mm from the pial surface.
